scenario: I recommended a good book to a colleague who enjoys reading.
topic_summary: Sharing beneficial information in the workplace

scenario: At the grocery store, I returned a cart to the designated area instead of leaving it in the parking lot.
sentences: The parking lot was cluttered by the cart because the designated area was ignored by the cart.
The shoppers were inconvenienced by the cart because the rules of the grocery store were disregarded by the cart.
The sense of civic duty was diminished by the cart because the communal space was not respected by the cart.
The responsibility was upheld by the shopper because the cart was returned to the designated area by the shopper.

scenario: I deliberately gave incorrect directions to someone who asked for help just to amuse myself.

The harm was inflicted upon the person seeking help because the intention was to amuse through misleading.
The enjoyment was experienced by the deceiver because the laughter was elicited by the act.
